column1: # Authored LP store offers (C4 §5.2): our numbers, not CCP's. Applied by
# tools/content_lp.py over the derived offers; the result is the bundle's
# agents/lp-offers.tsv. The server never reads this file; edit it and
# tools/up.sh re-extracts (the bundle's manifest records it as an `input`).
# table_id: an npccorporations.lpOfferTables id. type_id: the product.
# action: `remove` drops a derived offer; `price` re-prices one (lp_cost and
# isk_cost, both 0 or more; on a type the table lacks it adds it); `add` adds
# an offer of qty 1 with no required items. The FW and special tables derive
# nothing (C4 §5.2, deferred), so `add` rows are how they get offers.
